description: Turn on termination protection for a Cube. While on, `delete_cube` is rejected with 409 and the Cube cannot be destroyed by the customer — Krova (admin/orbit) can still terminate it, with an audit row. Power-off, wake, restart, snapshot, and restore remain allowed regardless. Idempotent: protecting an already-protected Cube is a no-op server-side. Toggle off with `unprotect_cube`.

cubeId.description: The Cube id to operate on.

spaceId.description: Krova Cloud Space id. Optional if KROVA_SPACE_ID is set as the server default.

name: protect_cube
title: Protect Cube From Termination
